owner_confirmation: Owner's "yes go" to the proposed next-step sequence: "Same-day-competing-catalyst sweep... then batch... then signoff... then attest."
sweep_method: For each of the 66 real frozen step-3 candidates (config/m2-step3-frozen-candidate-ledger.json), checked whether the same issuer filed any OTHER real 8-K/8-K-A on the identical calendar filing_date, using each issuer's own real, already-fetched full 'recent' filing history (the same browser-fetched data the freeze itself used). 4 of 66 candidates (6%) had another same-day filing; the other 62 had none and are unaffected by this policy. Each of the 4 was read in full from its own real primary document on sec.gov before applying the three-part test -- no verdict was made from the item number alone.

same_day_catalyst_test_applied.competing_item: Item 1.01 -- Open Market Sale Agreement (ATM equity program) with Jefferies LLC
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_dissemination: No press release exhibit anywhere in the filing -- only legal exhibits (the Sale Agreement itself, a Skadden Arps legal opinion, and XBRL data). No Item 7.01 Reg FD reference either.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_content: An enabling, open-ended ATM facility with no dollar size disclosed and no commitment to sell any shares ("the Company will set the parameters... from time to time"); routine ongoing capital-markets housekeeping for a clinical-stage biotech, not a specific, weighty new development.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.reasoning: Fails conditions 2 and 3 -- no independent dissemination and no fresh, sized, material content. A different real ASMB same-day situation from the one excluded in step 2 (2025-08-06, Phase 1a clinical data) -- that exclusion is unaffected and unrelated.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.disposition_note: Not excluded on this basis. Full disposition still pending the corporate-action check, identity/exchange re-verification, and a label-engine dry run -- none of which have run for any step-3 candidate yet.

same_day_catalyst_test_applied.competing_item: Item 9.01 only (8-K/A Amendment No. 1) -- corrected earnings release exhibit
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_dissemination: Not a separate disclosure at all -- the Explanatory Note states this amendment exists solely "to correct errors in the earnings release attached as Exhibit 99.1" to the original same-day filing: the narrative description of total revenue and net loss had referred to the wrong periods.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_content: This is not a competing catalyst by definition -- it is a corrected version of the exact same earnings release the candidate itself already represents, not independent new information.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.reasoning: Does not meet the policy's own premise of a competing disclosure -- it is an erratum to the candidate's own earnings release, not a second, different item. Recorded as a caveat since a reader of the real primary document should know the originally-filed earnings release had a since-corrected narrative error.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.disposition_note: Not excluded on this basis. Full disposition still pending remaining gates. Caveat: use the corrected (8-K/A) earnings release text, not the original, if filing text is read again later.

same_day_catalyst_test_applied.competing_item: Item 7.01 -- Regulation FD Disclosure (upcoming Investor Day)
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_dissemination: Separate Exhibit 99.1 press release announcing the event, same day as the Item 2.02 earnings release.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_content: The filing's own first sentence: "As previously announced, the Lovesac Company... will host its 2024 Investor Day on Tuesday, December 17, 2024." This is a compliance-driven Reg FD notice ahead of an already-disclosed future webcast, not new information disclosed for the first time that day.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.reasoning: Fails condition 3 -- same-day and separately disseminated, but explicitly not fresh ("as previously announced"). The policy's own orderly/already-telegraphed exclusion applies directly.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.disposition_note: Not excluded on this basis. Full disposition still pending remaining gates.

same_day_catalyst_test_applied.competing_item: Item 5.02 -- departure of SVP/Chief Human Resources Officer (Jennifer Kartono)
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_dissemination: No press release exhibit or Item 7.01 reference anywhere in the filing -- only the 8-K itself and the separation agreement as a legal exhibit.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.detail_content: A standard, orderly separation: effective date more than two weeks out (March 1, cessation of employment April 25), a conventional severance package (one year's base salary, incentive-plan payout, one year of COBRA) -- no disagreement, no "for cause" language, and a non-C-suite role (CHRO, not CEO/CFO/COO).
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.reasoning: Fails conditions 2 and 3, directly matching this project's own established OKTA precedent (docs/SAME-DAY-COMPETING-CATALYST-POLICY.md's own worked comparison) for an orderly, non-C-suite officer change.
same_day_catalyst_test_applied.disposition_note: Not excluded on this basis. Full disposition still pending remaining gates.

not_a_claim: Not a final disposition for any of the 4 flagged candidates -- only the same-day-competing-catalyst axis is resolved. They, and all 62 unaffected candidates, still need the corporate-action check, identity/exchange re-verification, and a label-engine dry run before any can honestly be marked 'included'.

Not a claim that every possible same-day issue is caught by this sweep -- it checks for another real 8-K/8-K-A filed by the same issuer on the same calendar day only. A competing catalyst disclosed through a different channel entirely (e.g. only a standalone wire release with no corresponding 8-K at all) would not be surfaced by this specific check; none of this project's own prior exclusions (MEI, ASMB step-2) were of that kind, so this is consistent with precedent, not a newly-discovered gap.
